title: Allow saving picture of the day wallpaper directly from lock screen
line: With the Picture of the Day wallpaper, the lock screen has a Save Wallpaper button that saves today's picture to the Pictures folder.
explanation: The Picture of the Day image could only be saved from the wallpaper settings, through a file dialog, and the lock screen can't show a file dialog. The lock screen also had no way to ask the wallpaper for its image. The POTD backend now has saveImageToPicturesFolder(), which copies the picture to the Pictures folder under the same default name as the dialog (adding " (1)" instead of overwriting), and the POTD wallpaper item exposes canSaveImage, saveImage() and imageSaveFinished(message). The lock screen footer shows a Save Wallpaper button whenever the wallpaper offers this and shows the result ("The image was saved as …" or the error) in its usual message line.

commits.message:
wallpapers/potd: allow saving the image without a Save dialog

The lock screen can't open a Save dialog, so the picture couldn't be
kept from there. Add a call that copies it to the Pictures folder under
a free name and expose it on the wallpaper item for the lock screen.

BUG: 484359

lockscreen: add a button to save the Picture of the Day wallpaper

Saving today's picture meant opening the lock screen settings and using
a file dialog. When the wallpaper supports it, show a Save Wallpaper
button in the footer that saves the image and says where it was saved.

BUG: 484359

patches.diff:
From 4bf689babfdd1037bb82d2d029a409d8a33b03ae Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:42:23 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen: add a button to save the Picture of the Day
 wallpaper

Saving today's picture meant opening the lock screen settings and using
a file dialog. When the wallpaper supports it, show a Save Wallpaper
button in the footer that saves the image and says where it was saved.

BUG: 484359
---
 .../contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml      | 22 +++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 22 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
index 065a33c131..70b3c21658 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
@@ -528,6 +528,28 @@ Item {
                 Layout.fillWidth: true
             }
 
+            PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
+                id: saveWallpaperButton
+
+                focusPolicy: Qt.TabFocus
+                text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Save Wallpaper")
+                icon.name: "document-save"
+                // Offered by wallpapers that can save their image without a Save dialog, like Picture of the Day
+                visible: wallpaper?.canSaveImage === true
+                onClicked: wallpaper.saveImage()
+
+                Connections {
+                    target: wallpaper
+                    ignoreUnknownSignals: true
+                    function onImageSaveFinished(message) {
+                        lockScreenUi.handleMessage(message);
+                        notificationRemoveTimer.restart();
+                    }
+                }
+
+                Layout.fillHeight: true
+            }
+
             Battery {}
         }
     }
--
